title: Divergence: forge::body_tv classifies a FRAME compile abort (spec-fn req, empty spec_defs) as Divergent — a fabricated infidelity (R-HONEST-3)

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Failing tests at forge/tests/divergence_body_tv_frame.rs::{spec_helper_req_straight_line_body_is_not_divergent, spec_helper_req_v1_while_loop_is_not_divergent} demonstrate the divergence (audit of #162, commit 540cea0d). Root cause: body_tv::corpus_req threads the source req VERBATIM into BodyObligationFrame/LoopObligationFrame with spec_defs: Vec::new(), so a req referencing a spec fn helper (the 'req sorted(haystack)' design idiom) makes the obligation an undefined-fn compile error; run_obligation maps the no-results non-success exit to CompileAbort -> BodyVerdict::Divergent ('a real body-lowering infidelity') + exit 1, although the production lowering is exactly faithful. The sibling exec_tv::check_corpus_expr gates the req on every referenced ident being env-declared, explicitly because otherwise it is 'a FRAMING failure, not an infidelity'. Worst on the loop arm: the ENTRY obligation (loop-tv.md REQ-2, proof fn with NO production text) compile-aborts on the frame and is reported 'the production loop text did not compile'. Authority: exec-stmt-tv.md REQ-5 (Divergent <=> lowering and reference DISAGREE; non-derivable frame = Skipped class), loop-tv.md four-way (Divergent = production-side counterexample). RELATED (same overclaiming family, not separately test-pinned: not deterministically reachable at the pinned rlimit 30 from the v1 .th surface): a genuine Z3 rlimit exhaustion emits 'Resource limit (rlimit) exceeded' WITH a results line counting it as an error (probed live), so Errors>=1 -> Divergent, while loop-tv.md pins 'Unverifiable - a Verus/Z3 timeout'. forge check distinguishes this via --profile (classify_verus_outcome Timeout); run_obligation passes no --profile. The fix should address both: gate/thread the frame like exec_tv (or thread spec_defs), and keep a timeout out of the Divergent class.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Critic discriminator plan: pin the divergence with two failing integration tests (forge/tests/divergence_body_tv_frame.rs) that spawn the forge binary on scratch .th fixtures (straight-line + v1 while-loop, each with a spec-fn-helper req) and assert the authority's expected classification (divergent == 0, exit 0 — exec-stmt-tv.md REQ-5 / loop-tv.md four-way / R-HONEST-3). Commit the failing pins to main as the block; the generator fixes (gate the req like exec_tv or thread spec_defs).

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: FIXED + re-critic-clean (c00600c3). The exec_tv-mirroring req gate (collect_text_idents character-identical to the sibling; undeclarable req -> Skipped with an honest framing-limitation reason, never blamed on the production) + the mapping hardening (CompileAbort -> Unverifiable in both arms; new Timeout via is_rlimit_signal -> Unverifiable; Divergent reachable ONLY from a genuine counterexample with no rlimit signal) + an in-file divergent_teeth mod (5 live tests incl. frame-abort->Unverifiable + the rlimit discriminator both ways). Re-critic NO DIVERGENCE: pins pass for the right reason (oracle unchanged); the gate does not over-skip (5 live boundary probes — param-only reqs + slice-len reqs still Faithful; u32::MAX/as-cast shapes Skipped, sibling-consistent); a real counterexample cannot carry the rlimit phrase (reasoned + teeth-pinned); loop combine still worst-wins; full gauntlet green.
